notes.title: Final update for now
notes.notes:
This will be the last update for now. There were a few lingering things I wanted to tweak, but as is often the case, everything is so interconnected that fixing one element can unexpectedly affect another.

The good news is — everything’s now working as intended! 🎉

As always, I’d love to hear your thoughts. If there’s anything you’d like to see adjusted or improved in future updates, feel free to reach out or leave a comment.

Thanks again for your support!
